# Jeremiah 40 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The-word which came to Jeremiah from-YHWH after Nebuzaradan [the]-captain-of [the]-guard had-sent-him from-Ramah, when-he-took-him and-he [was]-bound in-chains among-all the-exiles-of Jerusalem and-Judah who-were-being-exiled to-Babylon.

**2** And-YHWH spoke concerning Jeremiah freed by Nebuzaradan through-Jeremiah the-prophet in-those-days.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **40:1**: Opening formula for the Jeremiah freed by Nebuzaradan oracle. Historical and prophetic setting established.

- **40:8**: Central imagery of released prisoner — a defining element of this chapter's prophetic message.

- **40:16**: Concluding formula — ne'um YHWH. The divine speech seal.

— EMET
